Here we have for sale a preowned used copy of Beautiful Things Around You by Paul Henning.

 

A children’s’ picture book featuring colour photography published by Hachette in 1946.

 

The book was aimed at educating children in becoming aware of and appreciating the beauty to be found in everyday objects that surround them.

 

The first book of a planned series of three and that would also include further books on the seashore, animals and the French alphabet.

 

I have checked the books’ condition thoroughly and sanitised the dust cover.

 

The preowned vintage book and dust jacket are in very good used condition. The fly leaf has a dedication and has the previous owners name and address. (Please see photos)

 

All pages unmarked and un-creased. The dust jacket shows minor signs of wear to the edges. (Please see photos)

 

Please be aware that with preowned used items there may be small marks or flaws that are not mentioned because they are insignificant and do not detract from the look and quality of the item. (Please see photos)

 

The 28 page book measures approximately 22cm x 14cm.

 

A nice example of this post war children’s educational book featuring colour photography.

 

From a smoke and pet free home.

 

If you have any questions or need more photos of the Picture Book in Colour Photography then please message me prior to buying/bidding as the item is ‘sold as seen’ and we do not accept returns.

 

However if there is a problem when you receive your purchase then please get in touch with us to get the matter resolved quickly.

 

DELIVERY to mainland UK only - Your item will be sent promptly and well packaged by Royal Mail 2nd Class.

ebay:286295015354.description:
A very good condition 2004 First Edition copy of Paul Shambroom's 'Meetings'. This copy is signed - I asked Paul to sign it at the launch of the book at Rocket Gallery in London. There is a small crease on one of the pages (see pictures) but otherwise the book is in mint condition. Also included here are a signed publishers's card, the Private View invitation, press release and price list for the photographs.

Between 1999 and 2003, Paul Shambroom attended hundreds of town council meetings across the United States. Photographing the participants with a large format panoramic camera, his tableaux describe the humble practice of local government on an epic scale - echoing traditional portraits of the powerful, from European court to American history paintings, and the many representations of the 'Last Supper'. 

They are also explorations of small town America, inspired by the road trips of Walker Evans and Robert Frank. With the full minutes of each meeting included, this is a revealing documentary record of the practice of local democracy at the beginning of the 21st Century, and the strongest work yet of an important photographic artist.
